name: subagent-cost-guard
description: Cuts subagent spend — an Agent or Workflow dispatch that would silently inherit opus or fable is blocked until it names its model tier and workflow effort, so grep sweeps stop billing at Opus rates

gate_mode.title: Gate mode
gate_mode.description: deny blocks a dispatch that names no model; warn notes it to stderr only; off disables the gate and the session-start rules
